requirements.title: 行情信息压缩，而非拟合几条规则

requirements.acceptance: 分开当前字段、近中远历史、活动、困难样本和冻结用途；图形像不像不作唯一验收。

requirements.title: bar状态与序列状态的关系明确
requirements.requirement: 声明每个状态H_t的实际可见区间、分辨率、归一预热与运行记忆；z_t=E(H_t)可作该历史的序列表示。内部token或短前缀不得冒称同等完整历史。固定128滚动是旧实例，不再限制新架构。
requirements.acceptance: 同物理端点/上下文评价；短前缀冷启动、完整滚动与长期记忆分开。

requirements.title: 价格与数据处理可追溯
requirements.requirement: 以真实合约和时间区间处理，不拼连续主力；价格锚点/尺度、全部预热依赖、缺失活动、分区跨度及train-only统计明确。
requirements.acceptance: 每轮协议绑定原始数据和统计来源；数据窗口/标签和缓存核对；没有独立复算的部分注明。

requirements.title: 状态可复用，可支持分类/趋势/波动等用途
requirements.requirement: 冻结embedding后验证用途，配同信息原始输入、PCA、当前特征和简单指标基线；不把重训主模型拟合评价规则当语义学习。
requirements.acceptance: 同权重、同读取机会及事前门槛；历史状态描述不等于未来收益或开仓建议。

requirements.title: 保留未来逐bar外推方向
requirements.requirement: 真实新bar刷新后预测与没有新行情的自由概率递推分开；若预测真实未来embedding，其目标应是E(H_(t+h))，不可把缺少未来新bar的历史状态当真值。旧固定128示例仍是E(2..129)而非E(2..128)；概率头内部u不自动等同真实encoder状态。
requirements.acceptance: 状态相似度与新增价格增益分别评价；按步长给误差/基线skill/可用范围，不用未来重置或重新锚定。

requirements.title: 研究必须可归因、可证伪并逐步收敛

requirements.acceptance: 每轮只回答编号问题，记录有限结论、取舍和停止决定；最终独立留出另验。

requirements.title: 高效、可恢复的AutoDL交付
requirements.requirement: 本地只做合成测试/CPU数据与报告核验；真实模型在AutoDL；features/babel准备推送；成功失败均导出到/root/autodl-tmp/download。

requirements.title: 每轮更新计划并按六方面复查

architecture.state_token_mask: All arms: market reads only by own availability and never terminal state; state reads all available market+self. All6 layers may cross scale.
architecture.cross_resolution: Shared physical content has deterministic aggregation relations, not equality of full latent states. First matrix uses same-source views/shared encoder/physical targets, no extra cross-scale consistency loss; F04 supervision hypothesis retained separately.
architecture.state_self_logit_reference: ordinary content self logit plus explicit state-type relation convention; exact bias treatment pending
architecture.proposal_status: relation_value_candidate_under_design; no fixed first2/last4 partition or head time constants; 6/768/12 resource proposal unchanged
architecture.structured_candidate: all6 availability-causal blocks with bounded interval-relation bias; layers2-6 market-token V mixes current V with layer1 V
architecture.relation_map: bounded c*tanh(small MLP(phi)); exact parameterization and c not locked
architecture.value_residual: Vtilde_l,j=(1-alpha_l,h)*V_l,j+alpha_l,h*V_1,j; sigmoid layer/head coefficients; initial0.5 proposal; market tokens only; state self uses current V
architecture.value_source: layer1 input projection before any cross-token mixing, from mask-sanitized joint bar inputs

historical_decoder.input: z and physical interval query only; declared price reference for absolute display
historical_decoder.current_close: known reference excluded from reconstruction success; current shape/activity supervised
historical_decoder.constraints: positive price and OHLC geometry; nonnegative log1p V/OI; signed deltaOI derived
historical_decoder.query_encoding: physical end-age/duration/resolution; exact numerical encoding open_run_card_detail

objectives.historical: 0.6 price +0.2 shape +0.2 activity, proposal not optimality claim
objectives.price: half relative path, half adjacent differences derived from predictions
objectives.scale_and_age: fixed train field/period scales; view-average and valid agebands1-16/17-64/>64; age0 separate; missing not zero
objectives.future: teacher-forced Student-t conditional NLL over60 trading-minute returns; sigma fixed at origin; free-rollout evaluated separately
objectives.future_decoder: 2-layer GRU256, initialized and conditioned each step on z; nu2+softplus, positive scale floor; no fabricated future volume/OI
objectives.joint_lambda: lambda_M and lambda_P fixed before scores using common target scaling, initial gradients and resource qualification; not locked; positive from start, common LR warmup only
objectives.gradient_control: A/B encoder receives historical gradient only; C/D adds mask and future. All arms task heads receive matched unweighted task objectives; shared history head also trains mask. Separate head and encoder grads/clipping; detached auxiliary path for A/B.
objectives.age0_mix: supervised and separately evaluated; final mixing weight against historical agebands open_run_card_detail
objectives.masked: same historical query decoder on E(masked H_t); raw-minute dependency closure covers aggregates, previous-close ratios, rolling scales and public side info; only past targets excluding public current price anchor
objectives.mixed: clean and masked forward with shared encoder weights; fixed paired task/endpoint/query/mask schedule; combine encoder gradients before update; no whole-state equality loss
objectives.interpretation: history-type describes direct encoder gradients; auxiliary heads including shared historical decoder are trained comparably in all arms; implicit shared-head adaptation is common, not omitted

fairness.not_identified: individual relation versus Value contribution; individual mask versus future contribution; full recipe interaction estimable only with uncertainty support
fairness.selection: lastN primary; predeclared best secondary only
fairness.after_training: freeze all encoders; fit equally initialized/budgeted current-state and AR/direct-quantile readouts; raw/simple baselines
